entries.title: Custom connections list new models such as Claude Fable 5.2 as Reasoning profiles
entries.body: A connection you add in Settings → Intelligence now offers Reasoning profiles for models that came out after your version of Infinitary, such as Claude Fable 5.2, within a few hours of their release. A model you add takes the profile with its exact ID on its own, and Off is now called Not set (model's default), because some models think even then.
